metadata.name: Open a web page
metadata.author: recued-core
metadata.description: Use “Open a web page” in Recued. Open an http or https address in Chrome and return its page handle, address and title. A tab already showing it is answered as it is, without asking; otherwise a new background tab opens, which asks you first, unless you've allowed it on that site, and the ask shows the whole address. Never replaces a tab you have open.

url.help: The http or https address to open, in full.
url.label: Address
